section_summary.extract_value: This section (2.2.3) describes the measurement of Online Interpersonal Sexual Objectification (OISO) experiences using a six-item scale adapted from the Interpersonal Sexual Objectification Scale and tailored to QQ platform features. The instrument demonstrated good internal consistency (Cronbach's α = 0.82) and adequate factor structure through exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses, with a single factor accounting for 52.49% of variance and acceptable model fit indices.
